Watch:
Keep an eye on broader tech sentiment following Palantir's jump, but also monitor any signs of economic slowdown from AI displacement. Your leveraged positions need constant vigilance.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing the significant risk in your leveraged, deeply underwater positions.
plays: SOXL: Your -54.14% loss on this leveraged ETF is significant. Consider trimming or exiting, as these decay and margin amplifies drops.
